column1: # Malay words whose e is not read by the default rules, respelled: in a reading, e is always the
# schwa (e pepet, as in "besar") and é the e of "elok" (e taling). Looked up before the shared
# Indonesian table lexicons/id/overrides.tsv; an entry equal to its key cancels an Indonesian
# entry. Matching: the whole word, lower case; a word with a suffix (-nya -lah -kah -pun -ku -mu
# -kan -an -i) or a prefix (di- ke- se- ber- ter- per- pe- me-) uses the entry of its stem.
